name: rsearch
description: Research you can inspect, using native Claude or Codex.
long_description: Turn a focused question into a source-linked dossier with evidence levels, visible gaps and a record of the research performed. Choose Claude or Codex as your research provider and use rSEARCH directly in Claude Desktop. Research uses your installed and authenticated provider CLI and its normal credits.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check Node and the chosen provider CLI.

tools.name: research_start
tools.description: Start bounded research and return a run ID.

tools.name: research_cancel
tools.description: Cancel this server's active research run.

provider.title: Research provider
provider.description: Enter claude or codex. Install and sign in to that provider CLI first.

model.title: Optional model override
model.description: Leave blank to use your provider's model settings, or enter a model from your provider CLI's model picker.

readable_root.title: Optional readable repository root
readable_root.description: Repository context is read-only and must be inside this directory. Leave blank for web-only research.
